questions.sentence: Normalization stores each fact in only one ___, which avoids update anomalies.
A fully normalized design splits data into many tables that are linked by ___ keys.
Denormalization repeats data on purpose to make ___ faster, at the cost of more work on writes.
A write-ahead log records a change ___ the data page itself is written to disk.
After a crash, the database replays the ___ to bring its pages back to a consistent state.
Partitioning splits a large table into smaller parts according to the value of a ___.
